usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only identity anchors and two flagged unjustified conclusions exist. A reader learns only the basic identity (IMF MD since 2019, former EU Commissioner and World Bank chief executive) — nothing about what she actually did. The dossier never states its own gaps (empty dossier with no 'unknowns' section), so remainingQuestions is 0. One retained source (a 2020 C-SPAN IMF appearance) is unextracted/unclassified, adding no usable content. Minimal meeting prep is possible from the anchors alone, but no substantive detail, so conversationReadiness is 1. The unjustified conclusions are flagged, not asserted in the dossier, so no overclaims to report from dossier text.
